rules.title: Scope & Premise Check
rules.text: Before acting, state the intent in the push's commit messages and test its premises: name the domain terms and invariants the change relies on, and say what would make the premise false. A push whose intent is empty or a placeholder ('wip', 'fix', 'update') has no premise to check.

rules.title: Investigate & Blast Radius
rules.text: Trace who imports each changed module and which bounded context owns the state it touches. Under a merge or rebase, read both sides: the base, ours and theirs. The harness records the reverse-dependency set in the verification artifact so the reviewer sees the radius without re-deriving it.

rules.title: TDD & Root Cause
rules.text: Write the failing test or reproduction first, then fix the cause it exposes, not the symptom. A source change pushed without a test change has no failing test to show.

rules.title: Minimal Diff & Architecture
rules.text: Keep the change to what the intent asks for. Cut dead code and unrequested scope; do not cross a bounded context to save a line. Over the size budget, the intent must carry a 'Scope:' line saying why.

rules.title: Prove With Evidence
rules.text: Every claim in the push is backed by a command the harness ran: its exit code, its numbers and its limits. Anything not run is written as a caveat, never as a result.
